name: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: 1. Cook spaghetti. 2. Fry pancetta. 3. Whisk eggs and cheese. 4. Combine everything.

name: Scrambled Eggs
instructions: 1. Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and pepper. 2. Melt butter in a pan. 3. Add egg mixture and cook until desired consistency.

name: Pancakes
instructions: 1. Mix dry ingredients. 2. Mix wet ingredients. 3. Combine wet and dry ingredients. 4. Cook on a griddle.
